sections.text:
**Mild Diffuse disc bulge with posterocentral disc is seen at the L5-S1 level indenting the thecal sac with mild  narrowing of bilateral lateral recess and neural foramina** 

No subluxation / dislocation / spondylolisthesis is seen. 

Vertebral body, pedicle, transverse process, spinous process, lamina and articular surfaces are normal. Pars interarticularis appear normal. 

Facetal joints appear normal. 

No altered signal intensity noted in the lumbar vertebral body. 

The intervertebral disc seen at lumbar vertebra shows normal signal intensity. 

There is no altered signal intensity noted in the visualised part of spinal cord. 

Cord ends at L1 vertebral body and show normal signal intensity. 

Cauda equina & filum terminale appear normal. 

The iliopsoas and perivertebral soft tissues are unremarkable. Sacroiliac joint appear normal. 

The sagittal diameters of the lumbar spinal canal are as follows (in mm):
